summary: Created API route /api/filters/options that loads cleaned.csv data and returns distinct options for income categories, card categories, spend quintiles (labeled as Quintile 1-5), and tenure range (min/max).
action_summary: Implemented the route using the existing load_cleaned_data helper, with proper TypeScript types and response format.
implementation_notes: Used Array.from(new Set()) to get distinct values, mapped spend_quintile to labeled options, and computed min/max for tenure.
